rows.snippet: Tackle any project with cordless drills from Tractor Supply. Durable, powerful, and built for the farm or shop. Shop now! Cordless drills make tackling jobs around the farm, shop, or home a whole lot easier. Whether you’re hanging gates, fixing fences, or working on a new project in the barn, these handy tools offer freedom to move without being tied down by cords. Find the right cordless drill to keep your projects moving and your toolbox ready for anything that comes your way. Cordless drills are handy, hardworking tools for making holes and driving screws without dragging an extension cord across the shop, barn, or living room. They are useful for everyday repairs, weekend projects, fence work, furniture assembly, and all the little jobs that pop up around a home or property. Around a farm or rural property, a cordless drill earns its keep on jobs such as repairing gates, replacing hinges, mounting signs, attaching brackets, fixing stall hardware, and building simple storage. During the cooler months, it can help with indoor projects when outdoor work slows down, from assembling shop benches to preparing a mudroom for wet boots and coats. As the weather shifts and chores move between the house, garage, and barn, cordless convenience means less time hunting for an outlet and more time getting the job done. Keep a basic assortment of bits nearby, including several Phillips and slotted driver bits, nut drivers, wood bits, metal bits, and a bit sized for the fasteners you use most often. Let the drill do the work rather than forcing it, keep the bit straight, and back the tool out occasionally when drilling deep holes to clear dust and shavings.

Our premium extra virgin olive oils are proudly 100% California grown, varietal-specific, and crafted with care at every step. We grow, harvest, and mill our own olives—controlling the entire process from our groves to your table—to ensure exceptional freshness, flavor, and authenticity. To qualify as extra virgin, olive oil must be mechanically extracted without heat or chemicals and meet strict standards for purity, flavor, and low acidity—resulting in a clean, vibrant oil with no defects.
